construction.small_prime_rule: x0 = -a_p, d0 = -b_p mod p for the class (a_p, b_p)
construction.private_prime_rule: cells of S not in a small-prime class, in order (j, then i), get the consecutive primes > B, x0 = -i and d0 = -j mod q
construction.d0_rule: d0 = D + d0_index * M_d, (D, M_d) the CRT of the d0 conditions, 0 <= D < M_d
construction.x0_rule: scan: x0 = X + x0_index * M, (X, M) the CRT of the small-prime and private-prime x0 conditions, 0 <= X < M

ref.source: seeded random closed shape on which a coordinate pass changes a class
